answer: Clone keys flood early attest slots. A newcomer runs a 26h nectar drip: 7 queries on a 1024-source catalog, one every 200 min, ticket=sha256(pubkey||src||min). Tickets pass in order via a 14-min jetty every even hour. Two watchers open a 3-span bridge; each acks tickets i and i+1; weight stays 0 until all confirm in 90 min. Stake is 13.4 POA for 6 days; missed query costs 0.22 POA. A 180-key farm needs 1260 sources and 2412 POA. Peers recompute tickets and drop reused sources. Late jetty miss refunds -2.6 POA after 16h; duplicate source burns 28%; late span burns 4.1 POA and zeros weight 2d.
